# Motion preview clips

Walk_Loop, Jog_Fwd_Loop, Jump_Start, Jump_Loop and Jump_Land are from Quaternius's Universal
Animation Library, standard free release (2025). The glTF file contains only those five animations;
the original binary buffer is kept so its accessor offsets remain valid. The source snapshot is
https://github.com/J-Ponzo/gltf-universal-animation-library at commit
`e24c23cf2a1323488a3faa226ea7ea21f644b73e`, published June 10, 2025, with a CC0 1.0 license.
The creator's listing also marks the pack CC0:
https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library.

These clips are loaded only when a motion preview is requested. They are not embedded in exported
VRM or GLB avatars.
